brief: A small closed box with a lid to keep a pack of kitchen matches dry.

requirements.evidence: Single cell build: piece:0,0,0;full with hex-bin-full bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full) provides interior volume ~176x153x80mm, modest 220x218mm footprint. Bottom solid cover + top solid cover create enclosure.
Cover on top face (cover:0,0,0;full;top) acts as removable lid. Hex Cluster covers lift off without tools, so box can be opened/closed.

requirements.requirement: Keep pack of kitchen matches dry
requirements.evidence: Build is fully enclosed: all 6 outer faces capped (caps), bottom and top covered with solid covers, bin with solid walls/floor inside. No drain holes, grate or vent used - solid bin and solid caps/covers chosen specifically. Geometry shelters contents from dust/splash. However configurator does not model material waterproofing, seals, gaskets, dishwasher or moisture ratings - parts are 3D printed per user material choice, so true water-tightness cannot be verified or claimed.

finish.summary: Small closed box built from one hex cell: solid bin inside, solid bottom and top covers + 6 solid end caps fully enclose volume (~176x153x80mm interior). Top cover serves as lift-off lid. Enclosure shields from dust/splash but no seal/waterproof rating is verifiable in this system.
